race.description: Good Year Autocare Echuca Moama Hcp (56)
race.comment: BLACK RUTILE (1) missed the placings two runs back then improved last start but found one better over 2000m at Casterton, beaten 2 lengths. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot find winning ways from the favourable alley. MAKUSHA (5) turned in a much better effort last time out to score by 3.5 lengths over 2000m at Kilmore. Has his share of ability. Hard to beat again in this grade. PHANTOM'S CHASE (2) doesn't win out of turn, scoring just once from 17 starts. Again tasted defeat last start when seventh over 2050m at Wodonga but finds the right race to atone. DASHING DONKEY (8) has found top form since getting up to around this trip three starts ago and the stable is in form with a couple of long-priced winners in the last week or so.
